subject: scaling 3D data throughput
text:
Hi [NAME],

Saw you are growing your robotics team and thought now might be a good time
to connect.

We help ML teams like Woven (Toyota) and Motive scale 3D annotation
pipelines and improve training data quality. For context, Encord is a data
infrastructure scale-up, specializing in sensor fusion (LiDAR/Camera) and
data curation, allowing your engineers to focus on model performance rather
than data management.

Would love to share some insights on how we help boost data accuracy and
model training. Are you free for a 20-min check-in in the next days so we
can get things rolling before the holidays?

subject: scaling data throughput
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congrats on the launch of BrainPack - impressive to see such a robust
solution for embodied AI.

Wanted to reach out since we work with CV/ML teams to improve training data
quality and scale annotation pipelines, so teams can focus on boosting
model accuracy and speed to market. Quick context: Encord is a data layer
scale-up, helping over 200 AI teams across industries - we're especially
well versed in VLM use cases like physical AI, surveillance, and robotics.

Looks like there could be synergy to accelerate data throughput. Are you
free on Monday? Otherwise would love to chat in the new year.

subject: NVIDIA & Encord AI Leaders Dinner @ CES Vegas - Jan 7th
text:
Hi [NAME], 

We're co-hosting a small and exclusive dinner with NVIDIA for AI execs attending CES on Jan 7 at BOA Steakhouse. 

It'll be an intimate event with ~15 founders and senior execs to step away from the crowds, and connect in a relaxed setting. 

For context, Encord supports teams like Boston Dynamics, Thinking Machines Lab, Standard AI, and Focal Systems on advanced CV and ML Ops pipelines across modalities (text, audio, image, video, 3D).

I'd love to save you a seat - will you be in Vegas that night?

subject: [COMPANY] <> Encord
text:
Hi [NAME], 

We recently started working with Veriff and Onfido, and [COMPANY] came up as we were looking at teams solving similar IDV challenges. 

A common theme we hear is the need to quickly understand failure modes and tighten the feedback loop between model performance and training data - especially in high-stakes KYC/AML workflows where small error rates matter. Curious if this resonates with what you're seeing at [COMPANY]. 

For context, Encord helps IDV and FinTech teams to improve training data quality and evaluation across document, image, and video workflows to move faster without compromising accuracy. 

Would you be open to a 20-min conversation in early Jan to compare notes on how you're approaching this for [YEAR]?

subject: [COMPANY] <> Encord - chat
text:
Hi [NAME], 

Noticed you'd been checking out Encord so wanted to say hello :)

You and the [COMPANY] team seem to be working on some interesting document workflows, and I'd love to understand a bit more about how you're approaching data and annotation today. 

Encord works with teams like Reducto, Appfolio, and UiPath on similar problems, and it's always useful to compare notes. 

Would you be open to a short 20-min chat to walk through your current setup and use cases? I'm pretty flexible before Xmas or early Jan.

subject: [COMPANY] <> Encord
text:
Hi [NAME], 

We recently started working with Reducto and [COMPANY] came up during research - thought I'd reach out. We support teams like Appfolio and UiPath on high-volume, multimodal document pipelines (text, images, PDFs), helping them speed up annotation and improve QA. I imagine some of the challenges they face might resonate with you. 

Most teams we speak with are using LLM/NLP models for things like summaries, Q&A, classification. We're especially strong in pre-labeling at scale using your own LLM/OCR/VLM models or agents,  and giving your team a clean interface to review and correct labels efficiently.  

Would you have 20 mins before the holidays or early January to discuss your workflow and see if Encord could help?
